page.layout: One page of text, all lines centred. Running head at top with the page number at top left. Below the text: a printer's ornament line with "NB." between asterisks, and a woodcut ornament. Catchword "ANTI-" at the right below the last line.

main_text.l: Die vngewißheit der stunde deß Todts.
Merck diese ding mit stettem fleiß/
Dadurch wirst werden klug vnd weiß.

page.notes: The whole page is set in black letter; the main text is therefore not marked <bl>. Long s is written as plain s. "kürtze" is read with an umlaut; the dots are faint, so the reading is uncertain. The ornaments (a printer's hand device at the left and right of "NB.", and a woodcut ornament below the text) are decorative and are not transcribed. The second line of the "Zum dritten." item breaks as "Men-" / "schen.", and is joined here.
